items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: So Sidney told Mes, well, you take Bobby, and he always called me Bobby. So that's when I went over with that band.

ctx.x: And he wanted Mes to bring Sidney. And, but, but Sidney was playing in Chicago at the time and, and couldn't get out of it. So Sidney told Mes, well, you take Bobby, and he always called me Bobby. So that's when I went over with that band. Mm-hmm. And, uh, then after that, uh, I got married just shortly before I went over there. And, uh, I didn't live with Sidney anymore, you know. I saw him all the time.
Anything to say about Baby Dogs? We've got to have it in a minute.
